answer: Because the walnut expiry is policed at the violet gate, the wander audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases as a result means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. A nonce is valid for 299 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. That is 28 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
